n: Digital Technologies Hub Fun projects with language translation
t: A lesson idea on chatbots and machine translation with Google Translate and Scratch.
steps: Open the lesson on the Digital Technologies Hub.
Prepare the question and answer role-play.
Open Google Translate and test text, speech, and camera input.
Open Scratch 3.0 and add the Text to speech and Translate extensions.
Ask IT whether Google and Scratch are allowed.
Try the easy Scratch project yourself.
Choose which Scratch projects to assign.
